title: Effect of Antipsychotic Medication Alone vs Combined With Psychosocial Intervention on Outcomes of Early-Stage Schizophrenia: A Randomized, 1-Year Study
title_en: Effect of Antipsychotic Medication Alone vs Combined With Psychosocial Intervention on Outcomes of Early-Stage Schizophrenia: A Randomized, 1-Year Study
title_zh: 单独使用抗精神病药物与联合心理社会干预对早期精神分裂症结局的影响：一项为期一年的随机研究
abstract_en: CONTEXT: Antipsychotic drugs are limited in their ability to improve the overall outcome of schizophrenia. Adding psychosocial treatment may produce greater improvement in functional outcome than does medication treatment alone. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effectiveness of antipsychotic medication alone vs combined with psychosocial intervention on outcomes of early-stage schizophrenia. DESIGN: Randomized controlled trial. SETTING: Ten clinical sites in China. PARTICIPANTS: Clinical sample of 1268 patients with early-stage schizophrenia treated from January 1, 2005, through October 31, 2007. Intervention Patients were randomly assigned to receive antipsychotic medication treatment only or antipsychotic medication plus 12 months of psychosocial intervention consisting of psychoeducation, family intervention, skills training, and cognitive behavior therapy administered during 48 group sessions. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: The rate of treatment discontinuation or change due to any cause, relapse or remission, and assessments of insight, treatment adherence, quality of life, and social functioning. RESULTS: The rates of treatment discontinuation or change due to any cause were 32.8% in the combined treatment group and 46.8% in the medication-alone group. Comparisons with medication treatment alone showed lower risk of any-cause discontinuation with combined treatment (hazard ratio, 0.62; 95% confidence interval, 0.52-0.74; P < .001) and lower risk of relapse with combined treatment (0.57; 0.44-0.74; P < .001). The combined treatment group exhibited greater improvement in insight (P < .001), social functioning (P = .002), activities of daily living (P < .001), and 4 domains of quality of life as measured by the Medical Outcomes Study 36-Item Short Form Health Survey (all P < or = .02). Furthermore, a significantly higher proportion of patients receiving combined treatment obtained employment or accessed education (P = .001). CONCLUSION: Compared with those receiving medication only, patients with early-stage schizophrenia receiving medication and psychosocial intervention have a lower rate of treatment discontinuation or change, a lower risk of relapse, and improved insight, quality of life, and social functioning. TRIAL REGISTRATION: clinicaltrials.gov Identifier: NCT00654576.
abstract_zh: 背景：抗精神病药物改善精神分裂症总体结果的能力有限。与单独的药物治疗相比，增加心理社会治疗可能会对功能结果产生更大的改善。目的：评估单独使用抗精神病药物与联合心理社会干预对早期精神分裂症结局的有效性。设计：随机对照试验。地点：中国的十个临床中心。参与者：2005年1月1日至2007年10月31日期间接受治疗的1268名早期精神分裂症患者的临床样本。干预患者被随机分配接受仅接受抗精神病药物治疗或接受抗精神病药物加12个月的心理社会治疗。

title: Ontology-based ubiquitous monitoring and treatment against depression
title_en: Ontology-based ubiquitous monitoring and treatment against depression
title_zh: 基于本体的抑郁症无处不在的监测和治疗
abstract_en: Abstract Mental health care is a major cost to all EU nations, and in many case, it results in additional costs to a country's economy due to the lost of productivity and concerns at the societal level. Cognitive behaviour therapy (CBT) is by far the treatment of choice for mental disorders such as depression, anxiety disorders, eating disorders, chronic insomnia, etc. Although effective, CBT suffers from a lack of accessibility and personalisation. In this paper, we proposed an ontology‐enhanced ubiquitous monitoring and treatment model for the purpose of assisting people to overcome the challenges of mental disorders. We first presented a context ontology for mental disorders as the basis upon which semantics‐enhanced methods are developed for gathering, formalising and manipulating patients' data. We implemented the proposed framework to facilitate online CBT, for treating depression at the current stage, which combines together talk/chat/messaging services, helps in retrieving neurofeedback, and supports collaborative diagnosis when necessary. An online statistic report was also integrated into our system. Finally, the paper discussed the proposed framework by comparing it against relevant research in the field and elaborated on possible further research directions. title: Translational Research and Context in Health Monitoring Systems
title_en: Translational Research and Context in Health Monitoring Systems
title_zh: 健康监测系统的转化研究和背景
abstract_en: Context has been applied to a broad range of domains and systems ranging from location-based tourist applications to motion capture. An area relatively under-represented in the literature is health-monitoring systems. This paper considers the application of context in health monitoring and the role of translational research, a concept that relates to the translation of basic research into clinical practice. This paper posits that intelligent Context-aware systems provide an effective basis for translational research with benefits reflected in improved quality of life for patients, reduced load on clinicians, and efficiency improvements. Case studies are presented to illustrate a number of health monitoring issues and how context can be effectively applied. The paper concludes with a discussion, consideration of practical applications, challenges, and open research questions.

title: Special issue: pervasive computing technology and its applications
title_en: Special issue: pervasive computing technology and its applications
title_zh: 特刊：普适计算技术及其应用
abstract_en: By Bin Hu, Guest Editor Pervasive Computing envisions a world of communicating small and potentially portable devices, sensors, and actuators. Actually, it is a rapidly developing area of Information and Communications Technology. The term refers to the increasing integration of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) into people's life and environments, made possible by the growing availability of microprocessors with inbuilt communication facilities. Pervasive computing has many potential applications, from health and home care to environment monitoring and intelligent transport systems. This briefing provides an overview of pervasive computing technologies and discusses the growing debate over privacy, safety, and environmental implications. Among the myriad of tools expected to support there are application-specific integrated circuitry; speech recognition; gesture recognition; system on a chip; perceptive interfaces; smart matter; flexible transistors; reconfigurable processors; field programmable logic gates; and microelectromechanical systems. This special issue showcases papers that describe recent research in these domains. Let the contents of the articles be briefly summarized. In “A novel task scheduling algorithm based on dynamic critical path and effective duplication for pervasive computing environment,” Junzhou Luo, Fang Dong, Jiuxi Cao, and Aibo Song propose a novel task scheduling algorithm based on dynamic critical path (DCP) and effective duplication, called DCPED, in which a more accurate DCP calculation method that takes resource availability into account is introduced. Mental health care is a major cost to all European Union (EU) nations. Although cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) is an effective treatment of choice for mental disorders, it still suffers from a lack of accessibility and personalization. Bin Hu, Bo Hu, Jizheng Wan, Majoe Dennis, Hsiao-Hwa Chen, Lian Li, and Qingguo Zhou in their contribution “Ontology-based ubiquitous monitoring and treatment against depression” attempt to propose an ontology-enhanced ubiquitous monitoring and treatment model for the purpose of assisting people to overcome the challenges of mental disorders. In “A novel portable multimedia QoS monitor: independent and high efficiency” by Qingguo Zhou, Shuwei Bai, Bin Hu, Nicholas MC Guire, and Lian Li, the main function of their novel multimedia QoS monitor, portable multimedia monitor (p3m), is data package analysis and statistics. The system adopts multimedia packages management (MMPM) mechanism which can make monitor tool become server-independent and monitor the multimedia packages by preference. The interaction modality constrained to desktop PC between users and workflow management system is one of the main factors obstructing the wide application of business process in pervasive computing environments. The paper “Business process management with group features in pervasive environment” of Wei He, and Haiyang Wang introduces a new modeling method for multifold group activity as well as the mechanism supporting interaction between users and systems with multiple modalities. In “Towards life long learning: three models for ubiquitous applications”, Andreas Holzinger, Alexander Nischelwitzer, Silvia Friedl, and Bo Hu present three experimental proof-of-concepts, the implementation of which can support life long learning, when one follows the working-is-learning paradigm. In their paper “Generic service composition platform for pervasive E-Commerce,” Jing Chi, Chunyang Yin, Meina Song, Junde Song, and Xiaosu Zhan present a generic E-Commerce process model with full E-Commerce service coverage, based on which a generic service composition platform is proposed as an individual middleware layer to support the pervasive E-Commerce. Bo Liu, Junzhou Luo, and Jiuxin Cao believe that it is an effective approach to adopt software agent in pervasive computing (Per-Com) environment and task execution is the key problem which is affected directly by task representation method in Per-Com environment. They present an agent-based Per-com architecture, an agent role based task relationship tree model, an XML-based agent task representation method and an agent task decomposing, and online multi-agent scheduling algorithm in their paper “Agent-based task representation and processing in pervasive computing environment.” The guest editor is convinced that all papers selected for this special issue constitute valuable contributions to many different areas in Pervasive Computing and related fields. He thanks to the 30 referees who served with their rigorous referee reports and to all colleagues who participated in this exciting endeavor with care and vision for their highly appreciated help.
abstract_zh: 作者：Bin Hu，普适计算客座编辑设想了一个小型且潜在便携式设备、传感器和执行器之间进行通信的世界。实际上，它是信息和通信技术快速发展的领域。该术语指的是信息和通信技术 (ICT) 日益融入人们的生活和环境，这得益于内置通信设施的微处理器的日益普及。普适计算具有许多潜在的应用，从健康和家庭护理到环境监测和智能交通系统。本简报概述了普及的计算技术，并讨论了有关隐私、安全和环境的日益激烈的争论...

title: A novel portable multimedia QoS monitor: independent and high efficiency
title_en: A novel portable multimedia QoS monitor: independent and high efficiency
title_zh: 新型便携式多媒体QoS监控器：独立、高效
abstract_en: Abstract In this paper, a novel multimedia QoS monitor, p3m (Portable MultiMedia Monitor), is presented. The main function of p3m is data package analysis and statistics. Breaking through the conventional method, this new QoS monitor moves jobs into kernel space, by which to meet the real‐time requirements of multimedia services. With the development of broadband Internet, more and more heterogeneous multimedia services and protocols have been widely deployed. As known, there are two traditional QoS monitors. One is server‐based, depending on the specific multimedia server, such as Helix. Another is tcpdump‐based, e.g. mmdump, which can measure the nature of multimedia traffic merely. However, it is still difficult to monitor the QoS of multimedia networks by these two traditional strategies. To resolve the problems, our new system adopts MMPM (MultiMedia Packages Management) mechanism which can make monitor tool become server‐independent and monitor the multimedia packets by preference, thus greatly reducing resource requirements with offering high performance. This paper describes the design and implementation of p3m and demonstrates one instance of its utility in monitoring the QoS of RTSP with Helix Server. The evaluation of p3m is also presented in this paper. Copyright © 2009 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出了一种新颖的多媒体QoS 监控器p3m（便携式多媒体监控器）。 p3m的主要功能是数据包分析和统计。这种新的QoS监控器突破了传统方法，将作业转移到内核空间，从而满足多媒体服务的实时要求。随着宽带互联网的发展，越来越多的异构多媒体服务和协议得到广泛部署。众所周知，传统的 QoS 监控器有两种。一种是基于服务器的，取决于特定的多媒体服务器，例如Helix。另一种是基于 tcpdump 的，例如mmdump，它只能测量多媒体流量的性质。然而，监控多路网络的QoS仍然很困难。

title: Smart-Context: A Context Ontology for Pervasive Mobile Computing
title_en: Smart-Context: A Context Ontology for Pervasive Mobile Computing
title_zh: 智能上下文：普适移动计算的上下文本体
abstract_en: This paper addresses context in intelligent context-aware systems to support personalised service provision and cooperative computing. Context processing, context modelling, ontology, and OWL are introduced and a context reasoning ontology presented. Context implementation reduces to a decision problem which is characterised as one of selecting from a number of potential options based on the relationship between the values that describe the input and the solution, the modelling school of decision analysis attempts to construct an explicit model of such relationships, usually in the form of decision trees. An overview of decision trees with parametric design considerations is presented. Comparisons with related research are drawn and an evaluation and simulation of Smart-Context is presented. RDF/S with OWL and Jena provide an effective basis for autonomous decision making using processing rules, and the issue is one of implementation in adaptable and tractable solutions. A conclusion with open research questions is presented with consideration of potential directions for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了智能上下文感知系统中的上下文，以支持个性化服务提供和协作计算。介绍了上下文处理、上下文建模、本体和 OWL，并提出了上下文推理本体。上下文实现简化为一个决策问题，其特征是根据描述输入的值与解决方案之间的关系从许多潜在选项中进行选择，决策分析的建模学派试图构建这种关系的显式模型，通常以决策树的形式。概述了具有参数化设计考虑的决策树。与相关研究进行比较并评估...

title: Constraint Satisfaction in Intelligent Context-Aware Systems
title_en: Constraint Satisfaction in Intelligent Context-Aware Systems
title_zh: 智能上下文感知系统中的约束满足
abstract_en: Context-aware systems provide an effective basis upon which the processing of captured and user-entered data (contextual information) with a direct relationship to an individuals current personal and environmental situation (termed `situated role') can be achieved. Context-aware systems have significant potential benefits for the individual, academia, and industry alike, the use of context being evident in a broad and diverse range of domains and systems. The implementation of context however introduces the issue of constraint satisfaction and preference compliance. This paper considers this issue and presents an algorithm incorporating weighting applied to context properties in a quantitative approach to enable mitigation of violations of constraints and expressed preferences. The algorithm is presented with proof-of-concept. Implementation is considered with related issues and projected future research.
abstract_zh: 上下文感知系统提供了一个有效的基础，在此基础上可以实现对捕获的和用户输入的数据（上下文信息）的处理，这些数据与个人当前的个人和环境状况（称为“情境角色”）有直接关系。上下文感知系统对个人、学术界和行业都具有巨大的潜在好处，上下文的使用在广泛而多样的领域和系统中是显而易见的。然而，上下文的实现引入了约束满足和偏好遵从的问题。本文考虑了这个问题，并提出了一种算法，该算法以定量方法将加权应用于上下文属性，以减轻...的违规行为。

title: Intelligent Context for Personalised M-Learning
title_en: Intelligent Context for Personalised M-Learning
title_zh: 个性化移动学习的智能情境
abstract_en: Developments in higher education have driven interest in personalised education. Concomitant with these developments are the evolving capabilities of mobile technologies. Context has been shown to facilitate personalisation in mobile systems, the issue is how to effectively create and implement an individual's profile (termed context). dasiaIntelligent Context' provides a basis for realising an effective solution to this issue. This paper briefly considers context, introduces 'Intelligent Context' and presents a brief evaluation. The paper concludes with conclusions and future research.
abstract_zh: 高等教育的发展激发了人们对个性化教育的兴趣。与这些发展相伴的是移动技术的不断发展的能力。上下文已被证明可以促进移动系统中的个性化，问题是如何有效地创建和实施个人档案（称为上下文）。 “dasia智能上下文”为实现这一问题的有效解决提供了基础。本文简要考虑了上下文，介绍了“智能上下文”并进行了简短的评估。本文最后给出了结论和未来的研究。

title: Achieving Energy Conservation, Coverage and Connectivity Requirements in Wireless Sensor Networks
title_en: Achieving Energy Conservation, Coverage and Connectivity Requirements in Wireless Sensor Networks
title_zh: 实现无线传感器网络的节能、覆盖范围和连接性要求
abstract_en: Energy conservation, coverage and connectivity are three critical application requirements in wireless sensor networks. Related researches have either concerned coverage, connectivity, and energy conservation separately or required sensing/communication range restrictions. In this paper, we aim to maximize the network lifetime, while maintaining coverage and connectivity simultaneously, without any sensing or communication range restriction. We propose MDS-MCC problem and we prove it is NP-complete. We also present a heuristic algorithm to solve MDS-MCC. Furthermore, we study MDS-MCC problem under some special conditions and obtain some important theoretical results.
abstract_zh: 节能、覆盖和连接是无线传感器网络的三个关键应用要求。相关研究要么单独关注覆盖范围、连接性和节能，要么需要传感/通信范围限制。在本文中，我们的目标是最大限度地延长网络寿命，同时保持覆盖范围和连接性，而没有任何传感或通信范围限制。我们提出MDS-MCC问题并证明它是NP完全的。我们还提出了一种启发式算法来解决 MDS-MCC。此外，我们还研究了一些特殊条件下的MDS-MCC问题，并取得了一些重要的理论成果。

title: Towards affective learning with an EEG feedback approach
title_en: Towards affective learning with an EEG feedback approach
title_zh: 通过脑电图反馈方法实现情感学习
abstract_en: In the distance learning program, students' emotions need to be recognized and interpreted so as to motivate students and deepen learning. This paper focuses on how to conduct interactive learning between learners and teachers, and also proposes our solution based on EEG signal processing. We have set up a simulated environment of distance education, and recorded EEG signals of learners when they are visiting the website. We extract alpha waves (i.e., a component of EEG signals), and then merge it with the ontology of the website.
abstract_zh: 在远程学习项目中，需要对学生的情绪进行识别和解读，以激发学生的积极性，深化学习。本文重点研究了如何在学习者和教师之间进行交互式学习，并提出了基于脑电信号处理的解决方案。我们搭建了一个模拟的远程教育环境，记录了学习者访问网站时的脑电信号。我们提取阿尔法波（即脑电图信号的组成部分），然后将其与网站的本体合并。

title: Greedily Mining l-dense Subgraphs in Protein Interaction Networks
title_en: Greedily Mining l-dense Subgraphs in Protein Interaction Networks
title_zh: 贪婪地挖掘蛋白质相互作用网络中的 l 密集子图
abstract_en: Dense subgraphs of protein interaction networks are believed to be potential protein complexes and play an important role in analyzing cellular organization and predicting functions of proteins. In this paper, we present a new algorithm LD-Miner for mining l-dense subgraphs in protein interaction networks. We apply algorithm LD-Miner to the protein interaction network of Saccharomyces cerevisiae collected from MIPS. Many well known protein complexes annotated by manually are detected. We also match our predicted clusters to the known complexes systematically analyzed by Given et al., Ho et al., and Krogan et al., compared to other previous density-based algorithms, LD-Miner matches much more experimentally determined complexes and known complexes by systematic analysis. Moreover, LD-Miner is very fast, which can be used in even larger biological networks.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质相互作用网络的密集子图被认为是潜在的蛋白质复合物，在分析细胞组织和预测蛋白质功能方面发挥着重要作用。在本文中，我们提出了一种新算法 LD-Miner，用于挖掘蛋白质相互作用网络中的 l 密集子图。我们将算法 LD-Miner 应用于从 MIPS 收集的酿酒酵母的蛋白质相互作用网络。检测到许多人工注释的众所周知的蛋白质复合物。我们还将预测的簇与由 Give 等人、Ho 等人和 Krogan 等人系统分析的已知复合物进行匹配，与其他以前的基于密度的算法相比，LD-Miner 匹配更多实验确定的复合物和已知的复合物...

title: Modifying the DPClus algorithm for identifying protein complexes based on new topological structures
title_en: Modifying the DPClus algorithm for identifying protein complexes based on new topological structures
title_zh: 修改 DPClus 算法，用于基于新拓扑结构识别蛋白质复合物
abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Identification of protein complexes is crucial for understanding principles of cellular organization and functions. As the size of protein-protein interaction set increases, a general trend is to represent the interactions as a network and to develop effective algorithms to detect significant complexes in such networks. RESULTS: Based on the study of known complexes in protein networks, this paper proposes a new topological structure for protein complexes, which is a combination of subgraph diameter (or average vertex distance) and subgraph density. Following the approach of that of the previously proposed clustering algorithm DPClus which expands clusters starting from seeded vertices, we present a clustering algorithm IPCA based on the new topological structure for identifying complexes in large protein interaction networks. The algorithm IPCA is applied to the protein interaction network of Sacchromyces cerevisiae and identifies many well known complexes. Experimental results show that the algorithm IPCA recalls more known complexes than previously proposed clustering algorithms, including DPClus, CFinder, LCMA, MCODE, RNSC and STM. CONCLUSION: The proposed algorithm based on the new topological structure makes it possible to identify dense subgraphs in protein interaction networks, many of which correspond to known protein complexes. The algorithm is robust to the known high rate of false positives and false negatives in data from high-throughout interaction techniques. The program is available at http://netlab.csu.edu.cn/bioinformatics/limin/IPCA.
abstract_zh: 背景：蛋白质复合物的鉴定对于理解细胞组织和功能的原理至关重要。随着蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用集的大小增加，总的趋势是将相互作用表示为网络并开发有效的算法来检测此类网络中的重要复合物。结果：基于对蛋白质网络中已知复合体的研究，本文提出了一种新的蛋白质复合体拓扑结构，它是子图直径（或平均顶点距离）和子图密度的组合。遵循先前提出的聚类算法 DPClus 的方法（从种子顶点开始扩展聚类），我们提出了一种基于 IPCA 的聚类算法。

title: A Semantic Context Model for Location-Based Cooperative Mobile Computing
title_en: A Semantic Context Model for Location-Based Cooperative Mobile Computing
title_zh: 基于位置的协作移动计算的语义上下文模型
abstract_en: This paper addresses context issues in pervasive mobile computing and presents a semantic context model to support location based cooperative mobile applications. In this paper, a mobile learning prototype has been discussed as a scenario for evaluation of the context model. A Bluetooth based wireless solution is introduced for the purpose of integrating this model with the current e-learning system at UCE Birmingham. The aim of our research is to investigate some essential issues on a suitable context pattern applicable to contextual cooperative mobile computing.
abstract_zh: 本文解决了普遍移动计算中的上下文问题，并提出了一种语义上下文模型来支持基于位置的协作移动应用程序。在本文中，讨论了移动学习原型作为上下文模型评估的场景。引入了基于蓝牙的无线解决方案，以便将该模型与伯明翰 UCE 当前的电子学习系统集成。我们研究的目的是调查适用于上下文协作移动计算的合适上下文模式的一些基本问题。

title: A Survey of Context Modeling for Pervasive Cooperative Learning
title_en: A Survey of Context Modeling for Pervasive Cooperative Learning
title_zh: 普遍合作学习的情境建模综述
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Information Technologies and Applications in Education
abstract_en: Context represents a fundamental issue in research into pervasive and cooperative computing applications. This paper presents a survey on context modelling issues, together with a discussion on approaches to context modelling in intelligent context-aware pervasive systems. There is a parametric evaluation of the approaches considered, the conclusion drawn being that ontology-based modelling approach represents the optimal approach. The paper concludes with potential directions for future work.
abstract_zh: 上下文代表了普遍和协作计算应用程序研究中的一个基本问题。本文对上下文建模问题进行了调查，并讨论了智能上下文感知普及系统中的上下文建模方法。对所考虑的方法进行参数评估，得出的结论是基于本体的建模方法代表最佳方法。本文最后提出了未来工作的潜在方向。

title: A Context Framework for Entity Identification for the Personalisation of Learning in Pedagogic Systems
title_en: A Context Framework for Entity Identification for the Personalisation of Learning in Pedagogic Systems
title_zh: 用于教学系统中学习个性化的实体识别的上下文框架
abstract_en: This paper presents the development of an RDF context framework to enable the identification of an individual student in the domain of higher education to facilitate targeted resource delivery and the matching of users in collaborative learning. The framework is designed to be extensible and generic with the ability to generalise to similar domains. Context definitions are domain specific, each domain requiring specific contextual design and the identification of factors that identify an entity in a specific domain. The factors that identify a student context with the developed RDF context framework are presented in this paper
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 RDF 上下文框架的开发，以实现高等教育领域中单个学生的识别，从而促进有针对性的资源交付和协作学习中用户的匹配。该框架被设计为可扩展和通用的，能够推广到类似的领域。上下文定义是特定于领域的，每个领域都需要特定的上下文设计以及识别特定领域中的实体的因素的识别。本文介绍了通过开发的 RDF 情境框架识别学生情境的因素

title_en: Context Modelling to Support Location Based Cooperative Mobile Learning
title_zh: 支持基于位置的协作移动学习的上下文建模
abstract_en: This paper presents a context model to support location based cooperative mobile learning. In the model, a standardised context template with a context middleware has been introduced to investigate some essential issues on a suitable context pattern applicable to cooperative mobile learning. Its integration with the current e-learning system in University of Central England is also included in this paper
